name: Cross-dataset Wind Power Forecasting Benchmark
description: A cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating neural network models' ability to forecast wind power time series across multiple datasets and sites.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MAE (standard forecasting error metrics), often reported as normalized RMSE
reputation: Newly published cross-dataset benchmark with early adoption by researchers in wind-power forecasting and time-series generalization.
notes: Heterogeneous site/dataset characteristics and varying horizons make cross-dataset generalization challenging; dataset size and preprocessing differences can affect comparability. Not an LLM benchmark.
